2. New E7 SKU announced at $99 per user per month, incl M365 E5, Entra Suite, 
Agent 365, and M365 Copilot. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
3. M365 Copilot Wave 3 released, built in "close collaboration" with Anthropic's Cowork.
 
 
Expect E7 bundle upsells drive M365 Copilot, Agent 365 adoption; price hikes timely:
New Agent 365 offer brings agent registry/agent ID (in Entra), observability, risk signals, 
etc.—all important prerequisites for agentic adoption. Similar to M365 Copilot, see Agent 
365 adoption as unlikely standalone (via $30/mo, $15/mo SKUs) and instead expect 
both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force 
enterprise negotiations in 2H26, creating NT adoption catalyst.
 
Quantifying E7 opp: est ~325M enterprise seats, incl ~150M E3/E5 seats; est E7 = 
$100B annual upsell opp: See existing E3/E5 seats as highest propensity to adopt E7.
[2] <Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_2026128_RT000000003094331726.pdf.txt>
Over 80% of the Fortune 500 have active agents built using these low-code, no-code tools. As
agents proliferate, every customer will need new ways to deploy, manage, and protect them. We

believe this creates a major new category and significant growth opportunity for us. This quarter,
we introduced Agent 365, which makes it easy for organizations to extend their existing
governance, identity, security, and management to agents. That means the same controls they
already use across Microsoft 365 and Azure now extend to agents they build and deploy on our
cloud or any other cloud.
And partners like Adobe, Databricks, Genspark, Glean, NVIDIA, SAP, ServiceNow, and Workday
are already integrating Agent 365. We are the first provider to offer this type of agent control
plane across clouds.
[3] <Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_20251029_DN000000003082552535.pdf.txt>
80% of new developers on GitHub start with Copilot within the first week.
Overall, the rise of AI coding agents is driving record usage with over 500 million pull requests
merged over the past year. And just yesterday, at GitHub Universe, we introduced Agent HQ.
GitHub Copilot and Agent HQ is the organizing layer for all coding agent extending the GitHub
primitives like PRs, issues, actions to coding agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cognition,
xAI as well as OSS and in-house models. GitHub now provides a single mission control to launch,
manage and review these agents, each operating from its own branch with built-in controls,
observability and governance. We are building a similar system in security with over three dozen
agents in Copilot integrated across Entra, Defender, Purview and Intune. For example, with our
Phishing Triage Agent and Defender studies show that analysts can be up to 6.5 times more
efficient in detecting malicious mails.
In health, Dragon Copilot helps providers automate critical workflows. This quarter alone, we
helped document over 17 million patient encounters up nearly 5x year-over-year.
